item.title: WordPress and UnRaid
item.description: Overview This blog is something for me to look back at as a resource and to possibly help someone like you out. 1. Domain Names Make sure you have a domain name and that you have your ‘CNAME’s created so DNS can propagate. Pro tip, if you can change the TTL to 1 minute to help the propagation happen quicker. Googles default is 1 hour. (The items crossed out are dynamic dns names for my public IP)
